currentReview.scope: Read-only review of saved records; no source models or drawings were changed.
currentReview.sanitization: Private identifiers, dimensions, material grades, suppliers, paths, and thread IDs are omitted.

cases.title: Readable STEP with unresolved numerical and delivery requirements
cases.trigger: An actuator review package had exchange files that parsed successfully, but the declared numerical and deliverable criteria were not all closed.

recordedFindings.criterion: Independent STEP format and B-representation validity
recordedFindings.observation: The saved summary recorded valid format for all examined exchange files.

recordedFindings.criterion: Strict numerical equivalence across the package
recordedFindings.observation: Some independent-kernel and native-part volume comparisons did not meet the unchanged relative threshold of 1e-5. The saved summary left numerical equivalence open.
The saved summary explicitly recorded that the assembly roundtrip was not performed.

recordedFindings.criterion: Geometry, tooth definition, exchange closure, and independent manufacturing drawings
recordedFindings.observation: The requirements record retained open items and manufacturing_release=false.

cases.method: Maintain separate format, solid-count, numerical, re-import, drawing, and release results; keep the original reference and failed criteria.
cases.nextVerification: Resolve each open requirement on a controlled project copy, rerun the affected native and independent exchange checks, and inspect the required drawing coverage.
cases.reuseBoundary: A historical exchange result applies only to its saved version; it does not establish strength, life, thermal behavior, NVH, or manufacturing readiness.

cases.title: Discrete motion checks and an incomplete additional reopen
cases.trigger: A multi-joint demonstrator had saved clearance results for selected poses and transition samples, followed by an interrupted additional native-file reopen.

recordedFindings.observation: The saved sample records had successful transform checks and no reported intersections at their sampled states.
The saved attempt said additional_check_not_completed because the shared CAD session remained busy. It claimed no pass for that attempt.
Discrete samples do not prove clearance between samples or under physical load and tolerances.

cases.method: Preserve the earlier recorded results and the interrupted attempt separately; declare sample coverage rather than a continuous collision-free claim.
cases.nextVerification: Repeat native reopen in a controlled available session and use a justified continuous-clearance method for the project's motion envelope.
cases.reuseBoundary: The audit interpreted saved JSON records only; no hand model was reopened or moved.

cases.title: A clearance cut broke a protected wall
cases.trigger: A late interference repair enlarged an engine cavity and cut through an external wall.

recordedFindings.criterion: Protected wall and external closure after the cut
recordedFindings.observation: The retrospective documented a wall breakthrough discovered in CAD imagery despite successful rebuild and positive volume.

recordedFindings.criterion: Current verification of the reported wall restoration
recordedFindings.observation: The retrospective described restoring the wall; this audit did not inspect or remeasure the repaired native model.

cases.method: Name protected faces and minimum walls before a cut, then check local sections, wall thickness, external closure, and interfaces before refreshing downstream outputs.
cases.nextVerification: On the target project's version, capture and measure the local cut region, check protected boundaries, and rerun affected assembly and export criteria.
cases.reuseBoundary: This failure is documented by a retrospective, not by a fresh direct CAD inspection in this audit.

cases.title: Analytical kinematics passed while native motion-study replay failed
cases.trigger: An engine motion demonstrator used analytical checks and native CAD replay through different paths.

recordedFindings.observation: The saved analytical record reported passed=true for its sampled angular checks.
The saved record reported passed=false and included=false; the invalid study was removed.

recordedFindings.criterion: Dynamic loads, physical operation, and manufacturing readiness
recordedFindings.observation: Analytical motion and directly driven frame replay do not establish these engineering outcomes.

cases.method: Keep analytical, native-study, and directly driven replay results distinct; exclude a failed study rather than labeling the fallback as that study.
cases.nextVerification: Define the required native motion behavior and engineering criteria, then collect separate evidence for each on a controlled current project.
cases.reuseBoundary: The audit neither reran the analytical solver nor exercised native motion.
